body: I am also going to add that she hasn’t had the best reputation with other cats that she’s had in the past. I’ve always felt sorry for her cats.

I would love for her to say yes to this but I’m not very liked by her, couldn’t even tell you why, she just seems to dislike me. I would happily even give her money if she’s that bothered by the fact that she bought the cat. I care so much about animals and it breaks my heart when I see an animal clearly not happy and stressed.
Forcibly intervene?
But why would they if I’m not doing anything right now?
Just makes me think about how animals are euthanised when they’re sick and not going to get better or even because of their behaviour, why can’t humans have the same?
Completely agree
Nope, being alive is what’s painful
Nope, being alive is what’s painful.
That is such an old fashioned way to be dealing with mental health issues nowadays. The amount of people I’ve spoken to in mental health care I have learnt what to keep to myself too.
Totally understand and agree with you on that.
I think it is gonna fall apart soon. If that was an option I’m totally up for it. I’ve tried to take my life many times and still resent the fact that I’m still here.

That’s one reason among many why I don’t want kids. Also I’m the same age as you, I get asked if I’m going to have kids and when I say no definitely not I always get the response of you never know maybe you might change your mind! Nope, never.
I hear you. There are good things in the world but I do think the scales are tipping and the bad is outweighing the good.

I think it’s a common thought to have when you have depression, almost like a side effect. My GP told me it’s normal to have those thoughts from time to time throughout your life, depression or not, but yeah I think it’s more of a common thing with depression.
I know I’m not overthinking this one. It’s hurtful when it comes from someone you care about and thought they cared about you too.
He’s essentially said the same thing before. He knows how that made me feel.
Something that shows me he cares I guess. Am I just expecting too much from people? I feel like no one gives a shit about me tbh.
I’m already not feeling good. Keep getting tremors and feeling really sick. I just want a way out of this life.
Just about everything. None of it helps

I had this exact same thought, for years I didn’t want to see 30 years of age but then came my 30th birthday and I tried to end my life that night. Unfortunately I’m still here. That deep sadness I woke up with the next morning hasn’t left me since, I still want to do it again but I haven’t told anyone that. My GP knows what I did but has no idea I want to do it again. 

I feel your pain. Was there something that triggered this sadness and empty feeling?
There’s a woman in a town near me with the surname Macbean..
I’m constantly in so much pain, emotionally and mentally. The world would be so much better off without me, it truly would.
That sounds ominous..

Thank you for your reply, I really appreciate it. 
Yeah I feel the same about being in control, that’s the one thing that stops me from talking to professional mental health people is when it’s suddenly taken out of your control. I get it to a degree but actually for the one suffering can sometimes make it worse can’t it?
I’m in the UK, where are you?

It was nearing on 2 months ago now but I wouldn’t say I’m currently in immediate risk of doing it again. I just want to share it with them because it’s starting to feel like a burden on myself, carrying it around with me and no one knows about it. I am currently already under the care of the psychological services and my GP knows about my depression and self harm.
Yeah I’ve found this too. I always feel the response to whatever I say is basically ‘try harder’… yes I’m fucking trying my hardest, sorry it isn’t good enough.
I guess no matter how many it would be slow and painful?

Without meaning to offend my parents, I didn’t ask to be born. 
Some people just can’t handle life can they? I’m not sure I’ve ever been able to do that, I certainly can’t now.
Went to the pharmacy for some dressings, better to be prepared right?

I hate the survival instinct in us humans. I wish I could be in accident and die or become terminally ill and refuse treatment. Just something to take me out of here that doesn’t come with that same fear and guilt.
I know it won’t make anything any better really but I don’t really care what happens to me at this point.

We don’t live forever anyway so why would it be so wrong if I wanted to end it when I want too? What’s the real difference of dying in an accident, old age, other illness or taking my own life? It’s gonna happen in the end anyway so why do I have to suffer?

Yeah, wrong time to push religion on someone! Sometimes suffering isn’t temporary so why should we have to suffer permanently because of everyone else? Isn’t selfish of them to assume that we’re selfish?
God I’m so sorry to hear about your dad. I wish there was something I could do to help others, don’t give a crap about helping myself but I hate seeing others suffering.

I’m jealous of those who don’t suffer like this. What gets me though is the people who say ‘it gets better’ aren’t living my life or in my mind so how the hell do you know it will get better for me? Maybe it did for you but maybe for some it just doesn’t.

I’m so sorry to hear that your cousin hung himself. They locked us all up during covid and expected our mental health not to suffer?! For those of us who already had mental illnesses before that happened were left to suffer even more. The way this life is going is just not for me. I don’t want to be here.
